text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Trainer, looking back on this summer...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How could this be?! To think this summer 
would turn out so pathetic!
choice_data_list: Yeah, things have been feeling a b...
Yeah, things have been a bit stagn...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason herself was doing relatively 
well. However...
choice_data_list: Yeah, things have been in a bit of...
Yeah, things have been feeling a b...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ um~,
I gotta go to training~. I know I 
have to, but still~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I have the motivation, but my body just 
feels so heavy~. I wonder what's going 
on...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Dear No Reason-chan. Please wait just a 
little longer. You'll definitely get 
better"... and done.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Why is this happening? The 
more I run, the slower my times get...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Is the way I'm doing it bad? Or maybe...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mirako! Dantsu! Whatever is the matter?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"You two shone so brightly at the 
Takarazuka Kinen... Why now...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: W-Well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm truly sorry...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Trainer, why did such a blunder occur?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asked for my opinion, I think it over. It 
could just be natural fluctuations in 
condition, but if there's a specific 
reason...
choice_data_list: Maybe pushing yourself so hard cau...
Maybe pushing yourself so hard cau...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Reckless... you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A desperate dash, pouring out every ounce 
of their latent power. That day, the two 
of them raced across the battlefield with 
their lives on the line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The aftermath... Perhaps she couldn't 
fully recover from her extreme exhaustion 
in the intense summer heat...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. In other words,
the cause of 
this is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Summer fatigue! So that's what it is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Summer fatigue...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, under normal circumstances that 
would have relieved her fatigue. However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Under the intense summer sun, even that 
proved impossible, you see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe it really was summer fatigue... 
I did feel kind of sluggish~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So that's why my times hadn't been 
improving all this time.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! If that is the case, your 
condition should pick up with the arrival 
of autumn!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha,
no need to fret! Let us return 
to Tracen Academy to prepare for the next 
battle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three leave the training camp 
behind. Though the summer bore little 
fruit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry. Once my 
condition recovers, this autumn will 
surely...
